android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.explanation: Allows access to the Android Privacy Sandbox Advertising ID on Android 13+.
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.name: Access Privacy Sandbox Ad ID
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.user_impact: Allows advertising networks to identify your device for cross-app ad measurement.

android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATT.explanation: Allows the app to access Privacy Sandbox Attribution APIs to measure ad conversions.
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATT.name: Access Privacy Sandbox Attribution
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATT.user_impact: Measures ad clicks and conversion events across applications.

android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_TOP.explanation: Allows apps to access coarse-grained interest topics inferred from app usage for ad personalization.
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_TOP.name: Access Privacy Sandbox Topics API
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_TOP.user_impact: Allows ad networks to target ads based on high-level categories of apps you use.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.explanation: Allows an application to continuously access location even when running in the background without user interaction.
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.name: Access Background Location
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.user_impact: Enables 24/7 covert tracking of user movements and travel history.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.explanation: Allows an app to access approximate location derived from network location sources such as cell towers and Wi-Fi networks.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.name: Access Approximate Location
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.user_impact: Can estimate your location to city block or neighborhood level (approx 3 sq km).

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.explanation: Allows the app to access precise geographic location from GPS, Wi-Fi, and cellular cell towers. Required for turn-by-turn navigation, geofencing, and location tagging.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.name: Access Precise Location
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.user_impact: Can pinpoint your exact physical location to within meters.

android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION.explanation: Allows an application to read unredacted geographic metadata (EXIF GPS tags) embedded in user photos.
android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION.name: Access EXIF Media Geographic Location
android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION.user_impact: Extracts exact GPS coordinates where your photos and videos were captured.

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.explanation: Allows an application to view the state of network connectivity (e.g. connected, disconnected, cellular vs Wi-Fi).
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.name: View Network Connections
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.user_impact: Detects whether you have active internet connection.

android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.explanation: Allows an application to view information about Wi-Fi connectivity, such as whether Wi-Fi is enabled and connected network SSID/BSSID.
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.name: View Wi-Fi State
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.user_impact: Can inspect Wi-Fi connection status and network names.

android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.explanation: Allows an application to detect user physical activity such as walking, bicycling, driving, or standing still.
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.name: Physical Activity Recognition
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.user_impact: Enables behavioral profiling of your physical motion throughout the day.

android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS.explanation: Allows the app to answer an incoming phone call programmatically.
android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS.name: Answer Phone Calls
android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS.user_impact: Can automatically pick up phone calls without user consent.

android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.explanation: High-privilege system permission required for an app providing accessibility services. Can inspect all screen contents, capture keypresses, and perform taps on behalf of the user.
android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.name: Bind Accessibility Service
android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.user_impact: Can read all screen text, capture credentials, and click buttons automatically.

android.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN.explanation: High-privilege system permission enabling device management policies (e.g. enterprise lock, remote wipe, password enforcement).
android.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN.name: Device Administrator Binding
android.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN.user_impact: Can lock the screen, enforce passwords, or factory reset the device.

android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS.explanation: High-privilege system permission that allows an app to intercept, read, and dismiss all notifications from all apps on the device.
android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS.name: Bind Notification Listener Service
android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS.user_impact: Reads all notifications including OTP codes, chat previews, and banking messages.

android.permission.BIND_VPN_SERVICE.explanation: Allows an application to establish a local or remote virtual private network (VPN) tunnel, intercepting all device IP traffic.
android.permission.BIND_VPN_SERVICE.name: Bind VPN Service
android.permission.BIND_VPN_SERVICE.user_impact: Routes all network traffic through the app's VPN engine, enabling full traffic analysis.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE.explanation: Allows an application to advertise the device to nearby Bluetooth devices.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE.name: Broadcast to Nearby Bluetooth Devices
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE.user_impact: Emits Bluetooth beacon signals detectable by devices in proximity.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.explanation: Allows an application to communicate with already-paired Bluetooth devices on Android 12+.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.name: Connect to Paired Bluetooth Devices
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.user_impact: Can communicate with headsets, smart watches, and automotive units.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.explanation: Allows an application to discover and pair with nearby Bluetooth devices on Android 12+.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.name: Scan Nearby Bluetooth Devices
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.user_impact: Can discover nearby beacons, wearables, and infer physical presence/location.

android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.explanation: Allows an application to access health sensor data such as heart rate, pulse, or body temperature.
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.name: Access Heart Rate & Body Sensors
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.user_impact: Exposes real-time biometric and physiological health readings.

android.permission.BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROU.explanation: Allows an application to access body sensors while running in the background.
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROU.name: Access Body Sensors in Background
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROU.user_impact: Enables continuous biometric surveillance when app is not in use.

android.permission.CALL_PHONE.explanation: Allows an application to initiate a phone call without going through the Dialer user interface for confirmation.
android.permission.CALL_PHONE.name: Directly Make Phone Calls
android.permission.CALL_PHONE.user_impact: Can dial toll numbers or place unauthorized calls in the background.

android.permission.CAMERA.explanation: Required to access the camera device for taking photos, recording videos, or scanning QR/barcodes.
android.permission.CAMERA.name: Camera Access
android.permission.CAMERA.user_impact: Can capture photos and live video of user and surroundings.

android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE.explanation: Allows an application to change the state of network connectivity.
android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE.name: Change Network Connectivity State
android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE.user_impact: Can request specialized cellular network connections.

android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE.explanation: Allows an application to connect to and disconnect from Wi-Fi access points and turn Wi-Fi on or off.
android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE.name: Change Wi-Fi Connectivity
android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE.user_impact: Can toggle Wi-Fi connection and reconfigure wireless networks.

android.permission.ENFORCE_UPDATE_OWNERS.explanation: Indicates that the installer intends to claim exclusive ownership over updating the package on Android 14+.
android.permission.ENFORCE_UPDATE_OWNERS.name: Enforce Update Ownership
android.permission.ENFORCE_UPDATE_OWNERS.user_impact: Ensures that other app stores cannot overwrite this package without explicit user consent.

android.permission.FLASHLIGHT.explanation: Allows an application to toggle the device camera LED flash as a torch.
android.permission.FLASHLIGHT.name: Control Camera Flashlight

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.explanation: Allows an application to run persistent background services accompanied by a persistent notification.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.name: Run Foreground Service
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.user_impact: Enables persistent background task execution visible in the notification shade.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CA.explanation: Allows ongoing camera capture while the app is in the foreground service state.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CA.name: Foreground Service: Camera Access
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CA.user_impact: Allows video streaming or dashcam recording while screen is locked.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.explanation: Allows running a foreground service for uploading or downloading data.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.name: Foreground Service: Data Synchronization
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.user_impact: Standard background service for data transfers and synchronization.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LO.explanation: Allows continuous location tracking during navigation, exercise, or ride-share tracking.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LO.name: Foreground Service: Location Access
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LO.user_impact: Enables active route tracking accompanied by a persistent notification.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.explanation: Required on Android 14+ to run a foreground service that captures or mirrors the device screen.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.name: Foreground Service: Screen Capture / Projection
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.user_impact: Can record or stream everything rendered on your phone's display.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MI.explanation: Allows ongoing audio recording while the app runs in a foreground service.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MI.name: Foreground Service: Microphone Access
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MI.user_impact: Enables audio recording and voice capture while app is running in the background.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.explanation: Declares that the foreground service performs an uncommon task not covered by standard Android 14 types.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.name: Foreground Service: Special Use
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.user_impact: Runs ongoing background service with custom operational profile.

android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.explanation: Allows access to the list of user accounts recognized by the Account Manager (e.g. Google, email, and social accounts).
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.name: Discover Known Accounts
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.user_impact: Reveals registered account email addresses configured on the device.

android.permission.INTERNET.explanation: Allows the application to create network sockets and access the Internet via cellular data or Wi-Fi.
android.permission.INTERNET.name: Full Network Access
android.permission.INTERNET.user_impact: Enables sending and receiving data across the internet.

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.explanation: Special app access granting broad, unscoped access to all files on external storage, bypassing Scoped Storage restrictions.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.name: All Files Access / Manage External Storage
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.user_impact: Grants unrestricted read and write access to all user files across the filesystem.

android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS.explanation: Allows an application to modify global audio settings such as volume, routing, and speakerphone selection.
android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS.name: Modify Global Audio Settings
android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS.user_impact: Can adjust device volume levels and switch audio output devices.

android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.explanation: Allows apps to discover and interact with nearby Wi-Fi devices (Wi-Fi Direct, Aware) without fine location access on Android 13+.
android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.name: Scan Nearby Wi-Fi Devices
android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.user_impact: Interacts with local peer-to-peer Wi-Fi devices without revealing GPS coordinates.

android.permission.NFC.explanation: Allows an application to perform I/O operations over NFC to read contactless tags and exchange data.
android.permission.NFC.name: Near Field Communication (NFC)
android.permission.NFC.user_impact: Reads contactless transit cards, smart tags, or NFC accessories.

android.permission.NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT.explanation: Allows applications to receive NFC transaction events triggered by contactless payments or secure element transactions.
android.permission.NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT.name: Receive NFC Transaction Events
android.permission.NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT.user_impact: Can receive events when a contactless secure transaction occurs.

android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.explanation: Special permission allowing an application to read detailed history of which apps you use, launch frequency, and total screen time.
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.name: Access App Usage Statistics
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.user_impact: Exposes an exact timeline of your digital habits and application usage patterns.

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.explanation: Allows an application to display alerts, badges, and status bar notifications on Android 13 (API 33)+.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.name: Post System Notifications
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.user_impact: Allows app to send messages and attention-grabbing banners to the lock screen and notification shade.

android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.explanation: Allows an application to enumerate and inspect all installed packages on the device on Android 11 (API 30)+.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.name: Query All Installed Applications
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.user_impact: Provides a full inventory of every installed application on your phone, exposing personal interests and banking apps.

android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.explanation: Allows an application to read all calendar events, meeting subjects, attendees, and appointment notes.
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.name: Read Calendar Events
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.user_impact: Exposes private schedule, locations of meetings, and personal itinerary.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.explanation: Allows an application to read the complete call log history including dialed, received, and missed numbers and timestamps.
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.name: Read Call History
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.user_impact: Exposes metadata of everyone you speak with and call durations.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.explanation: Allows an application to read the user's address book, including names, phone numbers, email addresses, and relationship notes.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.name: Read Contacts
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.user_impact: Exposes your complete social and professional network contacts to the application.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.explanation: Allows an application to read files from external shared storage (photos, downloads, documents). On Android 13+, superseded by granular media permissions.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.name: Read External Shared Storage
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.user_impact: Allows broad access to user photos, downloads, and shared documents.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.explanation: Allows an app to read music and audio files from shared storage on Android 13 (API 33)+.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.name: Read Audio Files
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.user_impact: Allows access to stored music, voice recordings, and podcasts.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.explanation: Allows an app to read image files from shared storage on Android 13 (API 33)+.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.name: Read Photo & Image Files
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.user_impact: Allows access to all photos stored on the device.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.explanation: Allows an app to read video files from shared storage on Android 13 (API 33)+.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.name: Read Video Files
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.user_impact: Allows access to all video recordings on the device.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.explanation: Allows an application to read only user-selected photos and videos chosen via the system photo picker on Android 14+.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.name: Access User-Selected Media
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.user_impact: Privacy-preserving: only accesses the exact items you specifically pick.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.explanation: Allows read access to the device's assigned phone number(s).
android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.name: Read Device Phone Numbers
android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.user_impact: Directly links your physical phone number to advertising or tracking profiles.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.explanation: Allows read-only access to phone state, cellular network status, ongoing calls, and historical device identifiers (such as carrier and phone numbers).
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.name: Read Phone Status and Identity
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.user_impact: Can detect incoming/outgoing calls, cellular carrier, and device telephony status.

android.permission.READ_SMS.explanation: Allows an application to read stored SMS text messages on the device.
android.permission.READ_SMS.name: Read SMS Messages
android.permission.READ_SMS.user_impact: Exposes banking alerts, 2FA codes, and private conversations.

android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.explanation: Allows an application to receive the system broadcast after the device finishes booting, launching services automatically.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.name: Run at Startup (Boot Completed)
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.user_impact: Allows app to start automatically every time the phone powers on.

android.permission.RECEIVE_MMS.explanation: Allows an application to monitor incoming multimedia messages (MMS).
android.permission.RECEIVE_MMS.name: Receive MMS Messages
android.permission.RECEIVE_MMS.user_impact: Can intercept media attachments and photos sent via MMS.

android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.explanation: Allows an application to intercept and process incoming SMS messages.
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.name: Receive SMS Messages
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.user_impact: Can intercept two-factor authentication (2FA) OTP codes and private messages.

android.permission.RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH.explanation: Allows an application to monitor and receive incoming WAP push messages.
android.permission.RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH.name: Receive WAP Push Messages
android.permission.RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH.user_impact: Can inspect legacy telecommunication push signals.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.explanation: Allows an application to access the microphone audio stream for voice calls, audio recording, voice messaging, and speech recognition.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.name: Record Audio / Microphone
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.user_impact: Can record ambient sounds, conversations, and confidential audio.

android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAG.explanation: Allows an application to request deletion of installed packages via system confirmation dialog.
android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAG.name: Request Package Deletion
android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAG.user_impact: Can prompt user to uninstall applications.

android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTER.explanation: Allows an application to prompt the user to whitelist the app from system Doze and App Standby battery management.
android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTER.name: Request Exemption from Battery Saver
android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTER.user_impact: Allows continuous background activity without system power throttling.

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.explanation: Allows an application to request installation of new APK packages. Required for app stores and sideloading utilities.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.name: Request Package Installation / Sideloading
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.user_impact: Allows the app to prompt the system to install executable Android packages.

android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.explanation: Allows an app to schedule exact-time alarms for precise clock execution. Requires power consumption and wakeups.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.name: Schedule Exact Alarms
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.user_impact: Can wake up device from battery-saving sleep at precise millisecond intervals.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.explanation: Allows an application to send SMS text messages without user intervention.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.name: Send SMS Messages
android.permission.SEND_SMS.user_impact: Can incur financial charges via premium SMS or send unauthorized messages.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.explanation: Allows an app to draw alert windows and floating UI elements over any other running app. Used by floating widgets, but also high-risk for clickjacking and phishing.
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.name: Display Over Other Apps / Overlay
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.user_impact: Can obscure other applications or create invisible overlay tap targets (tapjacking).

android.permission.UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHO.explanation: Allows a designated package installer (app store) to perform unattended background package updates on Android 12+.
android.permission.UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHO.name: Update Packages Without User Action
android.permission.UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHO.user_impact: Allows approved app stores to update previously installed applications automatically.

android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.explanation: Allows an application to request user authentication via fingerprint, face unlock, or iris scanning.
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.name: Use Biometric Hardware
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.user_impact: Allows biometric authentication prompts (biometric templates remain protected in secure hardware).

android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM.explanation: Restricted permission for alarms, timers, and calendar applications to schedule exact alarms on Android 13+.
android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM.name: Use Exact Alarm
android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM.user_impact: Standard permission for clocks, alarms, and timers.

android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT.explanation: Legacy biometric permission allowing an application to use the fingerprint scanner for user verification.
android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT.name: Use Fingerprint Hardware (Legacy)
android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT.user_impact: Legacy fingerprint authentication interface; biometric data never leaves secure hardware.

android.permission.UWB_RANGING.explanation: Allows an application to determine relative position between ultra-wideband (UWB) devices.
android.permission.UWB_RANGING.name: Ultra-Wideband Ranging
android.permission.UWB_RANGING.user_impact: Measures precise distance and angle to nearby UWB tags and hardware.

android.permission.VIBRATE.explanation: Allows an application to trigger haptic feedback and device vibration.
android.permission.VIBRATE.name: Control Device Vibrator
android.permission.VIBRATE.user_impact: Causes the phone to vibrate for haptic feedback or notifications.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.explanation: Allows an application to hold a wake lock to keep the device CPU active while performing tasks with the screen turned off.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.name: Prevent Processor Sleeping (WakeLock)
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.user_impact: Keeps processor awake in the background, which can drain battery if misused.

android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.explanation: Allows an application to add, remove, or modify calendar events.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.name: Modify Calendar Events
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.user_impact: Can create false calendar events, alter invites, or delete appointments.

android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.explanation: Allows an application to write and delete entries from the system call log.
android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.name: Modify Call History
android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.user_impact: Can erase traces of malicious or unauthorized outgoing calls.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.explanation: Allows an application to modify or add contact data in the user's address book.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.name: Modify Contacts
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.user_impact: Can alter, corrupt, or delete contact records in your address book.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.explanation: Allows an application to write, modify, and delete files on external shared storage.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.name: Write to External Shared Storage
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.user_impact: Can modify or delete files, photos, or documents stored on device storage.

android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS.explanation: Special permission allowing an application to read or write system-wide configuration settings.
android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS.name: Modify System Settings
android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS.user_impact: Can change device ringtones, screen timeout, system brightness, and network behaviors.

com.android.vending.BILLING.explanation: Allows an application to offer digital goods and in-app subscriptions processed via Google Play Billing.
com.android.vending.BILLING.name: Google Play In-App Billing
com.android.vending.BILLING.user_impact: Standard framework for authorized in-app purchases and subscriptions.

com.android.vending.CHECK_LICENSE.explanation: Allows the application to verify with Google Play that the current user has licensed/purchased the app.
com.android.vending.CHECK_LICENSE.name: Google Play Licensing Check
com.android.vending.CHECK_LICENSE.user_impact: Standard anti-piracy licensing check with Google Play.

com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEI.explanation: Allows the app to receive push notifications via Google Cloud Messaging / Firebase Cloud Messaging.
com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEI.name: Firebase / Cloud to Device Messaging (Push)
com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEI.user_impact: Enables real-time push message delivery from servers to your device.

com.google.android.finsky.permission.BIN.explanation: Allows an application to query Google Play for campaign attribution data that caused the app to be installed.
com.google.android.finsky.permission.BIN.name: Google Play Install Referrer Service
com.google.android.finsky.permission.BIN.user_impact: Links your installation event back to the marketing campaign or ad link you clicked.

com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.explanation: Allows an app to access the Google Play Services Advertising ID for personalized advertising and user tracking.
com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.name: Google Play Advertising ID (AAID)
com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.user_impact: Permits tracking user interactions and conversions across different applications.
